title: Gol Gol Laddoo Ginti
objective: Count from one to five using festive sweets
story_concept: Dadi makes laddoos and the child counts each one as it lands on the plate.
lyrics: थाली में रखे एक, ओ मेरे बड्डू!
एक, दो, तीन, चलो गिनें हम,

lyric_lines: थाली में रखे एक, ओ मेरे बड्डू!

storyboard.description: Laddoos pop onto the plate one by one
lyric_lines: एक, दो, तीन, चलो गिनें हम,

audio_instructions: Warm, slow narration; pause after each number so children can repeat.

metadata.title: Gol Gol Laddoo | Hindi Counting Song for Kids
metadata.description: दादी के लड्डुओं के साथ एक से पाँच तक गिनती सीखें! An original Hindi counting rhyme for toddlers.
metadata.thumbnail_design: Smiling child holding a plate with five round sweets, big yellow Hindi text

originality_notes: Original lyrics and concept; no existing rhyme melody or text referenced.

title: The Puddle Parade
objective: Name four colours through rainy-day objects
story_concept: A duck leads a parade of coloured umbrellas and boots through puddles.
lyrics: Splash, splash, here comes the rain,
Red boots marching down the lane!
Yellow duck goes for a ride!
Green leaves dripping, drip, drop, drip,

lyric_lines: Splash, splash, here comes the rain,
Red boots marching down the lane!

storyboard.description: Blue umbrella and a yellow duck
lyric_lines: Yellow duck goes for a ride!

storyboard.description: Green leaves and a parade finish
lyric_lines: Green leaves dripping, drip, drop, drip,

audio_instructions: Bouncy tempo; emphasise each colour word.

metadata.title: The Puddle Parade | Rainy Day Colours Song
metadata.description: Splash through puddles and learn red, blue, yellow and green in this original sing-along for little learners.
metadata.thumbnail_design: Yellow duck in a puddle under a rainbow

originality_notes: Original lyrics; avoids the traditional 'rain rain go away' phrasing.
